note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Steps of browser/app screens are done by hand by the person recording.
prepare: Invoke-Command -Session $cli { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\MGLab | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\MGLab\ep14 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

if (-not (Invoke-Command -Session $cli { Test-Path 'C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe' })) { if (-not (Test-Path $msi)) { Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/PowerShell/PowerShell/releases/download/v$v/PowerShell-$v-win-x64.msi" -OutFile $msi }; Copy-Item -ToSession $cli -Path $msi -Destination C:\MGLab\pwsh.msi -Force; Invoke-Command -Session $cli { Start-Process msiexec.exe '/i C:\MGLab\pwsh.msi /quiet ADD_PATH=1' -Wait } }
$gwPw = Read-Host 'Password for the SQL login pbi_gateway_reader (owner types, never stored)' -MaskInput
Connect-PowerBIServiceAccount   # owner signs in as labadmin (interactive)

screens.name: before
steps: Desktop: blank query with C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep14\src\queries\sales-by-store.pq (server 10.50.0.30, database ContosoBikesDW), Close & apply with the SQL login pbi_gateway_reader; cards Sales Amount 1,862,401.98 and Order Lines 4,071, table by Store; save as ContosoGateway
Service: model ContosoGateway > More options > Settings > Gateway and cloud connections: record what it says when no gateway matches
Refresh now; Refresh history shows the failure; open Show for the details (record the wording)
mask: tenant domain, account picture and name, browser URL ids

screens.name: install
screens.app: Hyper-V console of CON-SRV02 (Windows Terminal + gateway installer + On-premises data gateway app)
steps: Windows Terminal, PowerShell 7, in C:\MGLab\ep14\src\ps: ./Test-GatewayHost.ps1 (all rows True, last line 7 endpoint(s) tested, 0 unreachable.)
Edge: download the standard-mode gateway from Learn's link; run the installer: default path, accept, Install
Sign in as labadmin; Register a new gateway on this computer; name contoso-lab-gw; recovery key typed off camera; Configure; summary page
Gateway app > Diagnostics > Network ports test > Start new test until Completed (Succeeded); Open last completed test results (Azure Relay hosts and ports)
mask: tenant domain in the sign-in e-mail
region-specific relay host names if they identify the tenant

screens.name: datasource
steps: Settings > Manage connections and gateways: cluster contoso-lab-gw listed and online

New > On-premises: cluster contoso-lab-gw, connection name Contoso Bikes DW (lab), type SQL Server, server 10.50.0.30, database ContosoBikesDW, authentication Basic with pbi_gateway_reader (password typed off camera), privacy level Organizational > Create: Created new connection
Terminal on the laptop or CON-SRV02: ./Register-LabDataSource.ps1 -GatewayName contoso-lab-gw -WhatIf -Verbose (GW003 Info line; ciphertext in the request body; creates nothing)

screens.name: bind
steps: Model ContosoGateway > Settings > Gateway and cloud connections: the SQL source with contoso-lab-gw selected > Apply (note how long after creating the data source it was offered)
Refresh now; Refresh history shows Completed
Open the report: Sales Amount 1,862,401.98, Order Lines 4,071, five stores (Lisboa 389,707.34, Madrid 366,058.87, Online 349,212.98, Paris 385,184.07, Porto 372,238.72)

screens.name: cert
steps: If the refresh failed: Refresh history, the failed entry > Show details: SQL Server certificate chain error (record the exact text)
On CON-SRV02, elevated PowerShell 7 in C:\MGLab\ep14\src\ps: Import-Module ..\ps\GatewayOps\GatewayOps.psd1; Set-GatewaySqlTrustedServer -Server 10.50.0.30 (shows Old and New and the .bak file)
Restart the gateway (gateway app > Service settings > Restart, or the Windows service; note which), Refresh now again: Completed
If the refresh already succeeded: show the SqlTrustedServers entry in the config file and say it was not needed; record what really happens

teardown: Invoke-Command -Session $s { sqlcmd -S localhost -E -b -i C:\lab\ep14\99-teardown.sql; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep14 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
# owner: uninstall the on-premises data gateway from CON-SRV02, remove the cluster contoso-lab-gw and the connection Contoso Bikes DW (lab) in the portal, delete the model ContosoGateway
owner_notes: Uses CON-SRV02 (only Desktop Experience member server; raise its memory to 4 GB for the recording, lab sizing). Database ContosoBikesDW comes from episode 11 scripts 01 and 02 (run them first if missing). Install of the gateway and sign-in are on camera by the owner.
